method.api: Cubism Core csmInitializeModelInPlace / reset all parameters to native defaults / set sampled raw parameter float values / csmUpdateModel
method.comparison: For every sample compare original full pose against identical pose with exactly ParamBrowLY, ParamBrowRY, ParamShiftY omitted; separately compare brows without ShiftY.
method.interpolation: Current old clip keyframes, smoothstep; 15 Hz endpoints plus every authored key time; float inputs stored in Core float32.
method.geometry_scope: Every XY coordinate of every vertex of every Native drawable, including hidden drawables; no opacity/visibility filtering.
method.interpretation: This is a Native geometry/opacity probe, not a pixel equivalence claim. Real paired renders are a separate gate. Extreme axis probes do not establish arbitrary combined-pose capability.
